provenance.preparation: Complete ground footprints and elevated building parts; source roof tags and part offsets retained; parts linked to mapped enclosing outlines; complete edge buildings omitted; context clipped in metres with Shapely; 0.5 m topology-preserving simplification. Elevation is supplied separately.

partSemantics.policy: An explicit building:part=no envelope uses valid linked parts when they reach the measured total height, or an exact lattice source note explicitly directs their rendering. Reviewed source-specific exceptions require their recorded source tags and complete named part set. Ordinary incompletely mapped outlines retain their fallback. No geometry is invented.

partCoverage.policy: Mapped part projections cover the parent outline and its holes within tolerance, with at least one valid ground part. Actual vertical offsets are preserved.
